allowed: verify the J15 manifest and all listed JSON/NPZ SHA-256 values
reconcile the archived QF relative residual, matvec roundoff bound, upper bound, limit, and raw spsolve metrics
calculate summary statistics and a descriptive frequency figure from archived values
write CSV, JSON, and PNG results under the new J16 output directory
prohibited: modifying J14/J15 source files, checkpoints, ledgers, contracts, or verdicts
recomputing or claiming the exact guard bound from absent archived matrices
changing or recommending an unsubstantiated residual threshold

indicators.qf_relative_residual_l2: Computed residual norm divided by max(||b||2, ||A x||2), as recorded by the solver.
indicators.qf_relative_upper_bound: Recorded outward-rounded upper bound including sparse matvec and subtraction roundoff.
indicators.approx_relative_roundoff_contribution: matvec_roundoff_bound / (residual_norm / relative_residual); this estimates the roundoff contribution relative to the residual denominator, not an exact recomputation.
indicators.spsolve_backward_error_eta_inf: Archived infinity-norm backward error for the separate raw SciPy diagnostic solution; it is not the QF guard metric.
indicators.frequency_conditioning: Only the four condition estimates actually archived are reported; no interpolation or inferred full-grid condition is allowed.

criteria.input_integrity: All 304 checkpoint JSON/NPZ files match the frozen manifest.
criteria.status_integrity: All 152 route statuses remain QF_GUARD_REJECTED and source run remains PYTEST_FAILED.
criteria.outputs: Produce a 152-row CSV, summary JSON, descriptive figure, and output hash manifest.
criteria.scientific_status: Analysis is diagnostic only; no mechanical PASS or exact independent recomputation is claimed.

resources.estimate: Hash 304 local files and analyze 152 small JSON records; no matrices or linear systems are assembled or solved.

status_policy: The J15 execution, all 152 route statuses, and the timeout/FAIL history remain unchanged.
